text: 过一般方法、冷热敷、中西药防治。药物渗漏的原因有药物因素、血管因素、临床护理操作因素；防治手段除热敷、冷敷、湿敷、中西药防治、封闭外，还可利用拮抗药或解毒剂。血管栓塞与肉芽肿的原因为不溶性微粒进入血管，可以通过建立医院静脉药物配置中心防治。Common Causes and Prevention and Treatment of Adverse Events Associated with Intravenous Infusion RAO You-yi，WANG Yu，MA Qing-yang（Dept. of Pharmacy，Mianyang Central Hospital，Sichuan Mianyang， 621000，China）ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE：To explore the common causes and methods for prevention and treatment of the adverse events associated with intravenous infusion，and to provide reference for rational drug use in the clinic. METHODS：Related literatures about adverse events associated with intravenous infusion were collected through the database，analyzed and classified. RESULTS & CONCLU-SIONS：The phlebitis is caused by drug toxicity，pH value，permeability pressure difference，insoluble particles，temperature and solvent of drugs；
